title: The Winds of Winter
series: A Song of Ice and Fire
description: The most eagerly awaited fantasy epic of the 21st century. As the Long Night looms and winter finally arrives, the battle for the Iron Throne becomes desperate while the Others advance upon the Seven Kingdoms.

title: Sunrise on the Reaping: A Hunger Games Novel
description: Return to Panem twenty-four years before Katniss Everdeen volunteered. Witness the 50th Annual Hunger Games—the infamous Second Quarter Quell won by sixteen-year-old Haymitch Abernathy of District 12.

title: The Lost Metal: A Mistborn Novel
description: The explosive climax of Mistborn Era 2. Wax Ladrian and Wayne uncover a conspiracy by the god Trell to destroy Scadrial, forcing them to push the frontiers of Allomancy and Hemalurgy to avert total cataclysm.

title: House of Flame and Shadow
description: Bryce Quinlan finds herself stranded in a strange new world, desperate to return to Midgard and Hunt Athalar. In the epic conclusion to the Crescent City trilogy, worlds collide as ancient enemies confront their ultimate destiny.

title: House of Sky and Breath
description: Bryce Quinlan and Hunt Athalar want a normal life after saving Crescent City, but the ruthless Asteri continue to tighten their grip on Midgard. As a rebel movement gathers momentum, they must make an impossible choice.

title: Wrath of the Triple Goddess
description: Percy Jackson needs three recommendation letters from the gods to enter New Rome University. To earn his second letter from Hecate, the goddess of magic, Percy and Annabeth agree to pet-sit her fearsome hellhound and polecat during Halloween.

title: The Sun and the Star: A Nico di Angelo Adventure
description: Demigods Nico di Angelo, son of Hades, and his boyfriend Will Solace, son of Apollo, venture into the darkest, most terrifying depths of Tartarus to rescue the heroic Titan Bob and fulfill a prophecy that challenges their love.

title: A Day of Fallen Night
description: Five hundred years before The Priory of the Orange Tree, the Dreadmount erupts and spews fire and wyrms across the globe. Four courageous women across three continents must unite to save humanity from the ashes.

title: Blood Over Bright Haven
description: In the magical refugee utopia of Tiran, Sciona Freynan becomes the first woman admitted to the High Magi. When she unravels the horrific hidden source powering the city's luminous spell-barrier, she must risk execution to expose the truth.

title: Hell Bent: An Alex Stern Novel
description: Galaxy 'Alex' Stern is determined to break Darlington out of purgatory, even if it costs her a future at Yale. Descending into the occult underworld of New Haven, she confronts murderous faculty, dark magic, and demons hungry for human souls.

title: The Familiar
description: In the opulent yet treacherous golden age of Madrid, Luzia Cotado conceals her magical gift of performing small miracles as a scullery maid. When her secret is uncovered, she is swept into a high-stakes tournament of illusions sponsored by King Philip II.

title: The Atlas Complex
description: The thrilling conclusion to the viral dark academia phenomenon The Atlas Six. Secrets of the Alexandrian Society are laid bare, fractures between the six caretakers deepen into open conflict, and the price of boundless knowledge becomes absolute.

title: Chain of Thorns
description: Cordelia Carstairs has lost everything she held dear in Edwardian London. As the demon Belial amasses an apocalyptic host to conquer the shadowhunter world, Cordelia and the Merry Thieves must face their deepest secrets to defend the realm.

title: A Curse for True Love
description: Two villains, one girl, and a deadly battle for happily ever after. Evangeline Fox must navigate stolen memories, vengeful curses, and the fateful love of the Prince of Hearts in the spellbinding conclusion to the fairytale series.

title: Heavenly Tyrant
description: Zetian conquered the throne of Huaxia and seized the imperial mecha. But ruling an empire divided between military factions, alien invaders beyond the Great Wall, and rebellious demigods tests her unyielding vengeance to its limits.
